result.notes:
Added 11 beacon events (orch.agent.questioned, run.warning, run.waiting, work.blocked, review.added, deviation.recorded/resolved, provider.rate-limited/quota-exhausted/fallback, input.rebuilt): closed event-data/v1 schemas, valid/invalid fixtures, EVENT_TYPES and unit.json, emission next to each beacon through conductor/infrastructure/beacon_events.py (subject <run>/<item>, correlationid = run id), sequence tests on characterization scenarios, deviation and run.warning tests, docs/events.md and CHANGELOG. Tests run: test_events, test_characterization (incl. new EventSequenceTests), test_boundaries, test_conductor_questions, test_conductor_advisor, test_conductor_autofix, test_conductor RunClockTests, all green. V1 not run by me.
